props.name: label
props.description:
Top label displayed above the slider.
Useful for identifying the field in forms.

props.name: labelHint
props.description:
Optional hint displayed to the right of the label.
Often used for contextual help or inline descriptions.

props.name: labelClass
props.description: Custom Tailwind classes applied to the label element.

props.name: containerClass
props.description:
Custom Tailwind classes applied to the outer container
that wraps the entire slider component.

props.name: min
props.description: The minimum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: max
props.description: The maximum allowed numeric value of the slider.

props.name: valueMin
props.description:
The current selected minimum value (left thumb).
This makes the component fully controlled.

props.name: valueMax
props.description:
The current selected maximum value (right thumb).
This makes the component fully controlled.

props.name: valueSuffix
props.description:
Optional string appended to displayed values.
Example: "kg", "₹", "cm", "hrs", "%".

props.name: error
props.description:
Error message to display below the slider.
If provided, the slider is styled with an error state.

props.name: showErrorMessage
props.description:
Whether the error message should be shown.
Defaults to true.
